I added `from __future__ import annotations` as the first import in all 20 modules under `shop/carriers/`. `__init__.py` is untouched, and the change is one added line per file with nothing else modified.

The new line sits directly above `import re`, after the TODO comment and the module docstring. It can't go any higher: Python only allows a `__future__` import after the docstring, and if it came first the docstring would stop counting as one. I imported every module to confirm the docstrings still load.

Tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` ran 6 tests and all passed.
